sentences.En vakker 70-årig dame satte seg ved sid: A beautiful 70-year-old lady sat down next to me and said good morning.
sentences.Jeg trodde at hun snakket i telefonen, m: I thought she was talking on the phone, but I was wrong.
sentences.Men... du... nei... tuller du bare?: But... you... no... are you just joking?
sentences.Etter å ha bodd i Norge to og et halvt å: Having lived in Norway for two and a half years now, I'm used to sitting quietly on the bus. I rarely chat with other passengers.
sentences.Jeg kom inn på bussen som vanlig,: I got on the bus as usual,
sentences.sto litt, og satte meg da jeg fant ledig: stood for a while, and sat down when I found a free seat.
sentences.Da bussen kjørte fra Birkelunden, satte: As the bus left Birkelunden, a beautiful 70-year-old lady sat down next to me.
sentences.Etter at hun satt seg, sa hun:: After she had sat down, she said:
She looked at me and said the same thing again.
sentences.Flott. Har du vært her lenge?: Great. Have you been here long?
sentences.Er det sant? Men… du… nei... tuller du b: Really? But… you… no... are you just joking?
sentences.Ja, det er sant. Og jeg hører det samme: Yes, it's true. And I hear the same thing everywhere in Norway.
sentences.Jeg ser ringen. Er du gift?: I see the ring. Are you married?
I got married six weeks ago.
sentences.Og kona di? Er han norsk?: And your wife? Is she Norwegian?
sentences.Nei, fra Syria, men han blir norsk om fi: No, from Syria, but she'll be Norwegian in four years. And besides: women are women wherever they come from.
sentences.Det er sant. (Og så lo hun.) Nå sitter a: That's true. (And then she laughed.) Now everyone sits with their phone. In the old days it wasn't like that.
sentences.Nå er det blitt vanskelig å snakke med f: Now it has become difficult to talk to people.
sentences.Jeg tenker på dem som Trump vil kaste ut: I think of the people Trump wants to throw out of the USA.
We got off the bus together.
sentences.Da vi sto på bussholdeplassen, sa hun:: As we stood at the bus stop, she said:
I want to say thank you very much for the chat.
And good luck with everything here in Norway.
sentences.Jeg så på henne med et stort smil:: I looked at her with a big smile:
sentences.Jeg gikk til høyre, og hun gikk til vens: I went to the right, and she went to the left.
Maybe that's what we're used to.
